text:
maya: deploy-bot started postdeploy smoke for release r-2026-eu1 at 08:10 UTC, baseline p95=115ms
deploy-bot: [automated] synth-pass started id=kv-prefill-eu1-9f3a; bucket=canary; timeout=6s
sam: initial run shows p95 ~760ms, a few 502s, looks like backend fetch spikes on prefix misses
kai: checking host metrics now 1: a couple hosts show GC pauses ~1.6s and higher net retransmits around 08:11
tessa: canary currently 25% in eu1. recommend pause and pin to stable until we dig in
maya: agreed, pining eu1 to v1.2.3 and halting new-variant traffic. sam, add rollback-pin note to the rollout ticket
sam: done. routing override applied at 08:14 UTC -> pinned to v1.2.3. note: caches might take ~90s to warm, avoid immediate re-run
deploy-bot: rollout comment appended "pinned eu1 -> v1.2.3 due to prefill latency spikes; host rotation + warmup planned" ticket=INC-5492
obs-bot: synth update before pin p95=760ms (08:12), after-pin snapshot p95=150ms (08:17), 5xx-rate dropped from 2.8% -> 0.3%
kai: extracting logs from host-62: 
```
2026-03-21T08:11:12Z host-62 gc_pause=1.62s prefix_miss key=mn-42 backend_fetch=478ms
2026-03-21T08:11:13Z net_retrans=9
```

maya: primary suspects: cold prefix cache + intermittent GC on minority of hosts. Plan: 1) pin (done) 2) sequentially drain+restart affected hosts 3) run low-concurrency warmup hitting top prefixes for 5m
tessa: +1. sam, can you extend the smoke grace window by +120s to reduce churn while warmup runs?
sam: updated smoke policy: prefill-grace +120s for rollout id r-2026-eu1 at 08:19
kai: will rotate hosts one at a time; estimated complete 08:28. warmup job started hitting top-100 prefixes at ~5 qps
obs-bot: post-warmup synth snapshot (08:27): p50=30ms p95=132ms 5xx=0.1% -> within thresholds
maya: thanks team. keep thread open 30m. once kai confirms rotations fully complete we'll run a 5% canary for 15m before promoting. :white_check_mark:
